summary: Ikebana International Asheville is Chapter #74 of the worldwide nonprofit Ikebana International, a membership club practicing Japanese ikebana flower arrangement under its motto 'Friendship through Flowers.' It holds monthly member programs and demonstrations, seasonal luncheons, and friendship gatherings, with instruction across four ikebana schools (Ichiyo, Ikenobo, Ohara, Sogetsu). The NC Arboretum exhibition in the listing is a public showcase the chapter mounts, not the chapter itself, but confirms the same club that meets and teaches regularly.

evidence.note: Listing states the exhibition is presented by 'The Ikebana International Asheville Chapter,' naming a specific organization rather than an ad hoc show.

Ikebana International headquarters' official chapter directory lists 'Asheville - Chapter 74' with links to its own website, Facebook page, and Instagram, confirming it is a chartered chapter of a national membership organization.

Chapter site states membership is open to anyone interested 'regardless of previous experience,' has a dedicated membership page, and lists monthly programs, seasonal luncheons, and friendship gatherings dating back to 2022, showing a persistent returning membership base and officer structure rather than a one-off exhibit.
Chapter maintains its own Facebook page (found via the national chapter directory), further evidence of an ongoing community presence beyond a single event.
